cohort: The study enrolled 7,016 childbirth women from January 1st, 2015 to December 31st, 2017 at Zhujiang Hospital.
finding: Women aged >=35 years showed the highest incidences of chronic medical and pregnancy-induced complications and abnormal neonatal birth outcomes, while women aged <=24 years had a high risk of preeclampsia.
mod_finding: The incidences of delivery modes changed across different years and maternal age groups.
